title: US school district weather-closing rules
description:
Published rules that US school districts use to decide whether to close or delay school for snow, ice and cold: wind chill and air temperature thresholds, snow criteria, forecast check times, decision times and the action taken. 77 districts in 35 states. Every row links its source (a district page, board policy or a dated news story quoting the district), and every source was read on 3 November 2026.

Most published cold rules sit between -20°F and -35°F wind chill (median -22°F). Only 3 of the 25 southern and mid-Atlantic districts publish a temperature; most publish road-check and decision times instead. 41 of the 42 districts that give a morning deadline aim to decide by 6 am.

Web page with the table and method: calculatesnowday.com/school-closing-rules.
